narrative.details:
Word is officially out on those whelps, adventurer. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.
